answer: In the basalt consensus architecture, each validator situated at a network knoll registers a dynamic opportunity-cost bond, wherein any malicious identity multiplication triggers a subgame-perfect slashing matrix. By incorporating zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, we prove that the delta of expected utility for an adversary committing staking collateral to Sybil generation is strictly negative. This establishes a robust, unique Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates all adversarial strategies.
